legacyPosts.title: From Tier-3 College to Scaling Swiggy’s Order Matching Microservice
legacyPosts.author: Rohan Mehta
legacyPosts.summary: How focusing on concurrency primitives, network socket debugging, and Kafka offsets landed me a senior backend role after graduation without 500 cold LinkedIn DMs.
legacyPosts.content: When I was in final year at Apex, every company asked for LeetCode medium + hard. But what actually differentiated my resume was building an end-to-end distributed cache with consistent hashing and benchmarking it with Locust. At Swiggy, we look for candidates who understand thread contention and garbage collection pauses in Go.

legacyPosts.title: What YC Founders Actually Look For When Hiring Student Builders
legacyPosts.author: Neha Kapoor
legacyPosts.authorRole: Founder & CEO @ HyperScale AI (YC W24 • Batch '19)
legacyPosts.summary: Skip 5-page resumes. If you can build a fast, working proof-of-concept that calls an LLM API and handles edge case errors idempotently, you will get hired in 48 hours.
legacyPosts.content: At HyperScale AI, we posted a ₹5,000 micro-bounty on LinkX for an idempotent webhook service. Three students submitted pull requests. The one who included unit tests and docker-compose got a paid summer internship offer that same evening. Proof of work beats pedigree every time.

legacyPosts.title: How to Co-Author an IEEE Research Capstone with Industry Mentors
legacyPosts.author: Dr. R.K. Verma & Aditi Rao
legacyPosts.authorRole: Dean R&D @ Apex & Solutions Architect @ Google Cloud
legacyPosts.summary: A blueprint for undergraduate students to publish peer-reviewed cloud infrastructure research by partnering with industry alumni co-guides.
legacyPosts.content: Industry co-mentors give academic research immediate production credibility. Last year, 4 student teams paired with Google Cloud alumni to deploy an edge autoscaler on real clusters. The resulting IEEE paper provided undeniable evidence for top-tier master’s admissions and international referrals.

legacyPosts.title: The Truth About ATS Scanners and Why Your 4-Page Resume Gets Rejected
legacyPosts.author: Vikram Seth
legacyPosts.summary: Recruiters spend an average of 12 seconds per candidate profile. How to format quantifiable impact metrics and repository links that convert into immediate screen calls.
legacyPosts.content: If your resume lists 20 skills without a single GitHub commit or quantifiable metric (e.g. reduced latency by 35%), it gets flagged as unverified. Always pair target roles with verifiable GitHub evidence or alumni endorsements.
